parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The cluster ID.

You can call the [ListClusters](~~87116~~) operation to obtain the cluster ID.

sub_parameters.name: Args
sub_parameters.description: The parameter that is used to run the post-processing script.

sub_parameters.name: Url
sub_parameters.description: The URL that is used to download the post-processing script.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the cluster resides. You can call the [ListRegions](~~188593~~) operation to query the latest region list.
